breast.dataset_name: UCI Breast Cancer Wisconsin & Epidemiological Risk Cohort
breast.dataset_limitations: Combines fine-needle aspiration nuclear cytology and validated epidemiological risk factors (Gail model co-factors). Biopsy features are optional in the clinical assessment.

lung.dataset_name: Kaggle Survey Lung Cancer & National Lung Screening Trial (NLST) criteria
lung.dataset_limitations: Calibrated against USPSTF 2021 smoking pack-year criteria and environmental radon/asbestos occupational registries. Emphasizes respiratory symptom presentation.

cervical.dataset_name: UCI Cervical Cancer (Risk Factors) Clinical Dataset
cervical.dataset_limitations: Derived from clinical patient records at Hospital Universitario de Caracas. Evaluates sexual history, Pap screening latency, and HPV vaccination status.

skin.dataset_name: HAM10000 Dermatoscopy & American Academy of Dermatology ABCDE Register
skin.dataset_limitations: Integrates photographic pigmentary and boundary metrics with clinical ABCDE melanoma surveillance criteria and Fitzpatrick skin phototypes.

colorectal.dataset_name: Colorectal Screening Surveillance & Harvard Cancer Risk Index
colorectal.dataset_limitations: Captures adenoma-carcinoma sequence risk indicators, hereditary Lynch/FAP co-factors, diet, physical activity, and red-flag gastrointestinal bleeding.

prostate.dataset_name: Prostate Cancer Prevention Trial (PCPTRC) & PLCO Screening Cohort
prostate.dataset_limitations: Models age, race/ethnicity incidence disparity, family history, lower urinary tract symptoms, and prior PSA threshold distributions.
